title.zh: 将数组分成几个递增序列

desc.zh: 重复最多的数逼出 f 条序列，发牌式分配证明 f × k ≤ n 也足够。
desc.en: The most repeated value forces f sequences; dealing round-robin proves f × k ≤ n is also enough.

concepts.name: Repeats force many sequences
concepts.description: A value appearing f times needs f different strictly increasing sequences, so f × k ≤ n is necessary.

concepts.name: Round-robin dealing
concepts.description: Dealing the sorted array into f piles keeps equal values apart and gives every pile at least floor(n/f) ≥ k numbers.
